title: Top spending category per account, 2025
prompt: For each account, which spending category (from debit transactions) had the highest total in 2025? You'll need account × category totals before you can rank within account.
grain: transaction → account × category totals → ranked within account → final: one row per account (its top category).
metricDefinition: sum(amount) per account per category (debit only, 2025); the category with the highest total per account.
transformationPlan: aggregate 2025 debit transactions to account × category totals
rank categories within each account by total, descending
referenceSql: WITH account_category AS (SELECT account_id, category, sum(amount) AS total_amount FROM transactions WHERE type = 'debit' AND occurred_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01' AND occurred_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' GROUP BY account_id, category), ranked AS (SELECT account_id, category, total_amount, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rn FROM account_category) SELECT account_id, category, total_amount FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1
